name: Discord Markdown Formatting
info:
Format the text of a message in Discord's Markdown format into an array with the text formatted to be used by the [ClickUp API](https://clickup.com/api/developer-portal/commentformatting).

## Inputs
 - **payload** Content of the message posted via Discord

## Outputs
 - **payload** Message content formatted to be posted via the ClickUp API

## Available formatting
 - **User Mention** <@123456789101112131>
 - **Bold** \*\*Example\*\*
 - **Italic** \*Example\*
 - **Bold+Italic** \*\*\*Example\*\*\*
inputLabels: msg.comment with the message text in Discord format
outputLabels: msg.payload with text formatted for the ClickUp API
